svg.title: 7-Block Neural-Symbolic Pipeline
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing the seven-block neural-symbolic pipeline for Zelda dungeon generation, including Block 0 data prep and explicit GA search mechanics.

text.style: white-space: pre; stroke-width: 1; font-size: 10px; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 50%;

svg.text: Block I: Search-based Mission Graph Generation
Block IV: Latent diffusion (U-Net backbone & attention stack)
Selected-resolution attention; modes: softmax / linear_hedgehog; graph-grid refinement via SpatialGraphConditioner
Block V: LogicNet steering (gradient bias during sampling)
Note: soft steering, not a hard constraint. Active only when logic_guidance_scale > 0

text.style: fill: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-anchor: middle; white-space: pre;

svg.text: Inference scales are config-driven (see configs/zelda_hmolqd.yaml); typical runtime examples vary by experiment.
Fast sampler and masked-room branches support distinct runtime parameter paths.

text.style: fill: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 28px; white-space: pre;
